question: What ritual action may be performed again at the conclusion of the preceding rite?
premises: The preceding rite has reached its end.
A daily fire offering is an available option.
Re-entering the inner space may be done again.
inference: At the end of the prior rite, one may again enter inside and perform the daily fire offering.
plain_english: At the end of that, one may again enter inside and perform the daily fire offering.
